chunks.text: I feel like all of the important values were already represented.
There might be a few that I personally prioritize a lot more than others.
For example, I would place a lot of emphasis on communal living, the importance of community, the importance of acceptance, equality, things like that.
I think equality as a concept wasn't something that was addressed in these societies.
I think I would prefer a world where there's no discrimination, there's no hate, things like that.
Obviously, it would be my utopia.
